messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for customer 'Ceres' (VPC, eu-west) — 5xx spike + token latency increase. Trigger: ceres-vpc-dedicated-pool-12. Severity: P2. Pager: oncall-sre-erin. Runbook: /runbooks/tenant-fallback.md :rotating_light:

oncall-sre-erin: I'm on it, joining VC. First look at metrics now. Can someone paste recent tail of inference logs?

ml-platform-jay: grabbing KV cache hit-rate and model worker errors. Seeing repeated KV cache miss storms, followed by OOM-ish worker restarts on q4-quantized model variant (model:c-rex-1.2-q4).

infra-nina: checking pool health: node pool 'dedicated-eu-ceres-12' showing 12/16 workers active, CPU fine but several GPU processes in CrashLoop with exit code 137. Kernel logs show OOM kill on worker process.

oncall-sre-erin: thanks. Hypothesis: cache churn + batching causing OOM on q4 path. Need to failover to safe variant or pin to lower memory footprint model. Jay, can we route Ceres to safe-variant (c-rex-1.2-int8-safe) temporarily?

ml-platform-jay: yes. Safe variant exists: c-rex-1.2-int8-safe (smaller KV layout). I can push a model-pin for the tenant with immediate effect, TTL 1h while we stabilize. Command: 
```
# apply tenant pin
rdwctl tenant pin --tenant ceres --model c-rex-1.2-int8-safe --scope vpc --expire 3600
```

infra-nina: we should also enable fallback routing to backup region if the eu-west pool degrades further. Can we throttle batch sizes as well to reduce memory pressure?

oncall-sre-erin: good call. Jay, apply pin. Nina, reduce max_batch_size to 8 for ceres route. Raj, please prep customer comms for a brief degraded experience.

ml-platform-jay: running pin now. Output: 
```
OK: tenant ceres pinned to c-rex-1.2-int8-safe (applied by ml-platform-jay). Active on routing plane in 3s.
```

deploy-bot: Notice: Routing config update applied to service-router:ceres-route (change-id: rcfg-8a7b). Related rollback token: rcfg-8a7b-rollback.

infra-nina: reducing batch setting. Pushing feature flag for ceres: 
```
service-router patch ceres-route --set max_batch_size=8 --set batching_timeout_ms=20
```
Applied. Confirmed new batching metrics showing immediate drop in per-worker mem usage.

oncall-sre-erin: monitoring latency and error rate. Any immediate customer impact? Anna / Raj?

account-ops-raj: pinged Ceres SRE and Product lead. I told them we're investigating and may apply a short model pin to a safe variant to reduce errors; they'll be on call. They asked for ETA — tentative 30min for initial mitigation and 2-3 hours for full root-cause + follow-up.

customer-success-anna: adding that legal/compliance asked if we touch keys or logs — confirm no data plane changes, only model routing; KMS/HSM unaffected. They requested an update if we plan a hard failover to another region.

ml-platform-jay: noting: no model weights re-encryption, no KMS ops. This is purely routing/pinning and batching config. Rolling metrics now: errors down from 12% to 1.8% in 2 min.

oncall-sre-erin: good. Keep observing. Nina, any signs of other tenants on same pool affected?

infra-nina: isolated to ceres pool; other tenants on the shard are healthy. We're seeing the cluster-level autoscaler suppressed due to commit limits; can spin up ephemeral burst nodes but need approval from eng-lead-ops for capacity.

eng-lead-ops: approving ephemeral burst up to 4 nodes for 1 hour to absorb load while we complete RCA. Cost acked. Nina, trigger.

infra-nina: provisioning ephemeral nodes now. ETA ~90s. Will attach to tenant pool in warm-up mode (no heavy batching until warm).

deploy-bot: Notice: New nodes attached (ephemeral-ceres-1..4). Health checks passing.

oncall-sre-erin: excellent. Two action items: 1) Pin applied (jay) & batching reduced (nina) — mitigation success window. 2) Postmortem path: gather traces and KV cache churn patterns for a detailed RCA. Raj/Anna to update customer with a short summary and timeline.

account-ops-raj: sending update to Ceres: "We've applied a temporary model pin to a lower-memory safe variant and reduced batching to stabilize. Error rate significantly reduced. We will continue to monitor and follow up with RCA in ~3 hours." Will paste copy into thread for review.

account-ops-raj: draft: "Quick update: We observed elevated errors caused by worker memory pressure tied to model caching behavior. We've pinned your tenant to a safe variant (c-rex-1.2-int8-safe) and adjusted batching. This should restore normal service; we will follow up with a full RCA and timeline for returning to the standard model. If you'd like, we can schedule a call. — Raj" OK to send? :thumbsup:

ml-platform-jay: looks good. Add note: "No customer data was re-routed outside eu-west."

account-ops-raj: updated and sent. Ceres replied: "Thanks — will monitor traffic from our side and escalate if anything else shows up."

oncall-sre-erin: monitoring for 15 more minutes then start handoff to next oncall with summary. Please add the following to the incident timeline: root cause hypothesis = KV cache thrash + batching spikes causing OOM on q4 quant path; mitigation = tenant pin to int8-safe variant + reduced batch size + ephemeral nodes.

ml-platform-jay: I'm capturing diagnostics: trace ids, sample inference logs, and worker cores. Will attach to postmortem: /incidents/3318765432/attachments.

infra-nina: note to SRE: autoscaler config needs tweak — current suppression prevented proactive node spin-up for tenants with high short spikes. Filing jira AUTOSCALE-482.

eng-lead-ops: also flagging Optimize team: batching heuristics should consider KV cache hit curves. Filing ticket OPT-309.

oncall-sre-erin: preparing handoff notes for next oncall (oncall-sre-kai). 
Handoff snapshot: 
- status: mitigated, error rate back to baseline but still monitoring
- actions taken: model pin applied, batching reduced, ephemeral nodes added
- next steps: collect full traces, confirm safe variant performance at 8k active qps, set 1h TTL on pin then evaluate extension
- contact: ml-platform-jay, infra-nina, account-ops-raj

oncall-sre-erin: @oncall-sre-kai will take next shift. I'm marking incident as monitoring-only.

deploy-bot: Notice: Feature flag ceres-route.max_batch_size changed (8) — change-id rcfg-8a7b.

oncall-sre-erin: closing loop here. If any regression, reopen thread and escalate. Good job everyone. :clap:

oncall-sre-erin: postmortem tag: incident-type: tenant-fallback, probable root cause: KV cache thrash -> OOM on q4 path. Mitigation: tenant pin + batching change + ephemeral nodes. Owner: ml-platform-jay / infra-nina. ETA for draft: 24h.

ml-platform-jay: attaching quick diff of fallback policy we used for record: 
```
fallback_policy:
  tenant: ceres
  primary: c-rex-1.2-q4
  safe_variant: c-rex-1.2-int8-safe
  action: pin
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  apply_scope: vpc
```

account-ops-raj: sent customer follow-up note with timeline + CC'd security for audit.

customer-success-anna: Customer happy with the quick mitigation. They asked to be notified before we unpin. I'll own that notification.

oncall-sre-erin: perfect. Handoff complete.
